data_objects.name: regional_monthly_home_prices
data_objects.meaning: Monthly regional real-estate records with geographic identifiers, place labels, size rank, and median sold price per square foot.

variables.name: RegionID
variables.meaning: Source identifier for the geographic region.

variables.name: RegionName
variables.meaning: Source display label or code for the region.

variables.name: State
variables.meaning: State abbreviation associated with the region.

variables.name: Metro
variables.meaning: Metropolitan-area label associated with the region.

variables.name: CountyName
variables.meaning: County or county-equivalent name associated with the region.

variables.name: SizeRank
variables.meaning: Source rank of the region by an unspecified size measure.

variables.name: Month
variables.meaning: Reference month encoded as year and month.

variables.name: MedianSoldPricePerSqft
variables.meaning: Median sold-property price per square foot for the region and month.

structure.description: Each row represents one RegionID and Month combination, with repeated geographic labels and a monthly median sold-price-per-area field.

uncertainties: The geographic type represented by RegionName, the basis of SizeRank, and the price currency are not stated.
The property population and transaction inclusion rules behind the median price are not documented.
annotation_notes: The per-square-foot basis is explicit in the source name; its currency remains unspecified.
